text: For a reservoir with N features, what are the per-step compute cost and the memory cost of maintaining P in RLS?
choices: O(N^3) per step and O(N^2) memory
O(N^2) per step and O(N^2) memory
O(N) per step and O(N) memory
O(N^2) per step and O(N*T) memory for T training steps
explanation: Each RLS step is a matrix-vector product plus a rank-1 update, both O(N^2), and it stores only the N x N matrix P, giving O(N^2) memory independent of T. O(N*T) is batch memory (storing all states); O(N^3) would be re-inverting from scratch.
